dm1945x3-cadaverine-physical-scale-down-.interpretation: The lower SDR 12 concentration is experimental evidence for sensitivity to the simulated combined gradients. It is not an observed loss following cultivation at industrial scale.

dm1945x3-cadaverine-physical-scale-down-.interpretation: The 73% value is retained with the source denominator and rounding; no absolute control value is invented from the percentage.
